char_style.description: The formatting of a run of characters. Every field is optional; an absent field has the application default (font `Inter` Regular, size 72, opaque white fill, no stroke, scales 100, ligatures on).

baseline.description: Baseline option. `Normal`: on the baseline; `Superscript`: raised and reduced; `Subscript`: lowered and reduced.

baseline_shift.description: Shift of the baseline in layer pixels, positive up.

fill.description: Fill colour: straight RGBA 0..1, binary32, authored-colour encoding.

font.description: Font family name (`Inter`). The font file is the node listed for (family, style) in the project node's `fonts`.

h_scale.description: Horizontal glyph scale in percent: 100 = unscaled.

Manual.description: Kerning after the character in 1/1000 em.

kerning.description: Kerning: `Metrics` (the font's pairs), `Optical` (from glyph shapes), or {"Manual": n}.

anyOf.description: Line advance in layer pixels; null: automatic (1.2 * size).

leading.description: Line advance in layer pixels; null: automatic (1.2 * size).

size.description: Font size in layer pixels per em.

small_caps.description: Lower-case letters shown as small capitals.

tate_chu_yoko.description: Horizontal-in-vertical setting of the run (vertical text).

tracking.description: Extra advance after every character, in 1/1000 em.

v_scale.description: Vertical glyph scale in percent: 100 = unscaled.

items.description: [axis tag, value]: a variable-font axis (`wght`) and its setting (binary32).

vertical_roman_upright.description: Latin characters stand upright in vertical text.

ease.description: The temporal ease on one side of a key, for one dimension (profile document 6.3).

influence.description: How far the ease reaches into the adjacent segment, as a fraction of that segment's duration. Clamped to 0..1 when used.

speed.description: The rate of change at the key on this side, in value units per second (for a spatial property: units of path length per second).

expression.description: An expression attached to a property: program text in the expression language (node `expr-language`, profile document 6.18). It is CONTENT and is never run by opening the file.

enabled.description: False: the expression is kept and not evaluated; the property has its keyframed value.

feather_point.description: A variable-width mask feather point on a path.

radius.description: Feather radius in layer pixels: positive feathers outward, negative inward.

segment.description: Index of the path segment the point sits on: segment i runs from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (the closing segment of a closed path from the last vertex to vertex 0).

t.description: Bezier parameter of the point on that segment, 0..1.

tension.description: 0..1: 0 blends the radius smoothly to the neighbouring points, 1 linearly. Default 0.

file_ref.description: A file an effect parameter names (a LUT, a colour configuration), carried in this package.

anyOf.description: The node holding the file's bytes; null when the file could not be read when the document was saved (the effect then has no file).

node.description: The node holding the file's bytes; null when the file could not be read when the document was saved (the effect then has no file).

origin.description: The path the parameter held when the file was embedded. A note for a person: no reader opens it.

frame_rate.description: A frame rate as an exact fraction: num / den frames per second (24000/1001, 25/1...). One frame lasts 254016000000 * den / num ticks.

gradient.description: A gradient: colour stops and opacity stops along 0..1. Colour at position p: the two neighbouring colour stops mixed linearly per component (the first stop's colour before it, the last after it; no stops: opaque white); its alpha is then multiplied by the opacity found the same way from the opacity stops (no stops: 1).

items.description: [position, [r, g, b, a]]: position 0..1; the colour is straight RGBA, 0..1, binary32, in the encoding of authored colours (profile document 6.8).

then.description: an item of a list the user orders (a shape item, a text animator, a selector, a layer style)

kind.description: an item of a list the user orders (a shape item, a text animator, a selector, a layer style)

then.description: one mask of the layer (profile document 6.10)

color.description: The outline colour in the editor, 8-bit r, g, b. No effect on the picture.

feather_falloff.description: The shape of the feather. Default `Smooth`. `Smooth`: a Gaussian ramp; `Linear`: a straight ramp.

inverted.description: True: c = 1 - c before the mask opacity is applied.

kind.description: one mask of the layer (profile document 6.10)

locked.description: Locked in the editor. No effect on the picture.

mode.description: How this mask's coverage c combines with the coverage A of the masks before it. `None`: the mask cuts nothing; it is a path for effects; `Add`: A = A + c - A * c; `Subtract`: A = A * (1 - c); `Intersect`: A = A * c; `Lighten`: A = max(A, c); `Darken`: A = min(A, c); `Difference`: A = |A - c|.

motion_blur.description: Mask motion blur. Default `SameAsLayer`. `SameAsLayer`: blur an animated mask path when the layer's motion-blur switch is on; `On`: always; `Off`: never.

roto_bezier.description: The editor derives the tangents from the vertices. The stored tangents are what counts. Default false.

then.description: one effect instance; its children are its parameters

effect.description: The effect id (`ec.blur.gaussian`). What it means is in the node `effect-catalog`.

kind.description: one effect instance; its children are its parameters

then.description: the Essential Properties of a layer whose source is a composition: one child per control the nested composition exposes

kind.description: the Essential Properties of a layer whose source is a composition: one child per control the nested composition exposes

overridden.description: The children whose values this layer overrides in its instance of the nested composition. Default empty.

group_kind.description: What a group is, with the data of it that does not animate. `kind` says which: `Plain`: an ordinary group; `Indexed`: an item of a list the user orders (a shape item, a text animator, a selector, a layer style); `Mask`: one mask of the layer (profile document 6.10); `Effect`: one effect instance; its children are its parameters; `Tracker`: one motion tracker; `Essential`: the Essential Properties of a layer whose source is a composition: one child per control the nested composition exposes.

keyframe.description: One keyframe. Its time is LAYER time (profile document 6.2).

auto_bezier.description: True: the key's eases are NOT taken from in_ease / out_ease when it has a key on both sides; they are derived from its neighbours (profile document 6.3). Default false.

continuous.description: The two eases are kept equal by the editor (a display flag; evaluation uses the stored eases). Default false.

in_ease.description: Eases of the arriving side: one per dimension of the value, or one for a spatial property or a value without dimensions; dimension d uses entry d, else entry 0, else speed 0 and influence 1/6. Default empty.

in_interp.description: Interpolation of the side ARRIVING at the key. Default `Linear`. `Linear`: this side of the key is a straight segment; `Bezier`: this side is a Bezier ease given by the key's ease on this side; `Hold`: as an OUT side: the value stays the key's value until the next key; as an IN side: like Linear.

label.description: A colour label for the key in the editor: 0 = none, 1..16 index the label list (Red...DarkGreen). Default 0.

out_ease.description: Eases of the leaving side, as `in_ease`. Default empty.

out_interp.description: Interpolation of the side LEAVING the key. Default `Linear`. `Linear`: this side of the key is a straight segment; `Bezier`: this side is a Bezier ease given by the key's ease on this side; `Hold`: as an OUT side: the value stays the key's value until the next key; as an IN side: like Linear.

roving.description: The key's time was computed by the editor so that speed along the path is constant between the neighbouring non-roving keys. The stored `time` is already that time; a reader evaluates it like any key. Default false.

spatial_auto.description: True: the spatial tangents are derived from the neighbouring keys (profile document 6.4) and `spatial_in` / `spatial_out` are ignored. Default TRUE.

spatial_continuous.description: The two spatial tangents are kept collinear by the editor (a display flag). Default false.

spatial_in.description: Spatial tangent of the motion path arriving at the key, relative to the key's value (x, y, z). Used only by spatial properties with `spatial_auto` false. Default [0, 0, 0].

spatial_out.description: Spatial tangent of the motion path leaving the key, relative to the key's value. Default [0, 0, 0].

time.description: When the key is, in the layer's time. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

value.description: The value at the key. Every key of a property has the same kind as the property's `value`.

marker.description: A marker on a composition's or a layer's time ruler.

chapter.description: Chapter name (for exports that have chapters). Default empty.

navigation.description: True: a navigation cue point; false: an event. Default false.

duration.description: Length of the marked span; 0 = a point. Default 0. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

frame_target.description: Web link frame target. Default empty.

label.description: Default `Red`. A colour label: a display aid with no effect on the picture.

protected.description: Composition markers: the span is a protected region - a time-stretched layer whose source is this composition plays it at its original speed (profile document 6.2). Default false.

time.description: Where the marker is: composition time for a composition marker, LAYER time for a layer marker. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

url.description: A web link attached to the marker: content, never opened by a reader. Default empty.

hold_only.description: The editor creates only Hold keys for it. Default false.

keys.description: The keyframes in ascending time, no two at the same time, when they are NOT stored in the owner's keyframe-tracks node (profile document 6.5). Absent or empty: no inline keyframes.

match.description: What the property IS within its group (`position`, `opacity`, an effect parameter's id): the name a reader goes by. Not unique among siblings of an indexed list.

shown_dims.description: How many dimensions the editor shows (2 for a 2D position stored as Vec3); 0 = all. Default 0.

spatial.description: True: a 2D or 3D value moves along a motion path between keys (profile document 6.4). Default false.

static_only.description: The property cannot be animated. Default false.

three_d_only.description: The property applies only when its layer is 3D. Default false.

track.description: Index of this property's keyframe track in the owner's `core.keyframe.tracks` node (the payload's `tracks` field names the node). Never present together with a non-empty `keys`.

two_d_only.description: The property applies only when its layer is 2D. Default false.

uid.description: The property's id: unique in the project, never reused, unchanged by rename and reorder.

value.description: The static value: the property's value when it has no keyframes.

children.description: The nodes of the group, in order. Default empty.

enabled.description: False: the group does nothing (an effect that is switched off, a hidden shape item). Default true.

match.description: What the group IS within its parent (`transform`, `masks`, `effects`, a shape item's kind...).

uid.description: The group's id: unique in the project, never reused.

node.description: A node of a property tree. `node` says which: `Prop`: a property; `Group`: a group of nodes.

children.description: The nodes of the group, in order. Default empty.

match.description: What the group is; the root of a layer is `layer`.

opentype.description: OpenType features asked for. All optional, default off.

stylistic_sets.description: Bit i (value 2^i) asks for stylistic set i + 1 (`ss01`...`ss20`).

then.description: an angle in degrees, shown as revolutions + degrees

kind.description: an angle in degrees, shown as revolutions + degrees

then.description: a mask of the property's own layer: a Scalar holding its 1-based position among the layer's masks, 0 = none

kind.description: a mask of the property's own layer: a Scalar holding its 1-based position among the layer's masks, 0 = none

then.description: a number with a valid range and a (narrower) slider range

kind.description: a choice from a list; the value is an Enum index into `options`

then.description: a file; the value is `File` (in this package) - in the application's memory a path string

items.description: A file-name extension without the dot, lower case.

kind.description: a file; the value is `File` (in this package) - in the application's memory a path string

param_ui.description: How a property is presented and edited. It never changes what the value means. `kind` says which: `Number`: a plain number; `Percent`: a percentage (100 = 100 %); `Angle`: an angle in degrees, shown as revolutions + degrees; `Pixels`: a length in pixels; `Point`: a 2D point; `Point3`: a 3D point; `Color`: a colour; `Checkbox`: a switch; `Layer`: a layer of the composition; `Mask`: a mask of the property's own layer: a Scalar holding its 1-based position among the layer's masks, 0 = none; `Path`: a Bezier path; `Text`: text; `Gradient`: a gradient; `Hidden`: internal data, not shown; `Slider`: a number with a valid range and a (narrower) slider range; `Popup`: a choice from a list; the value is an Enum index into `options`; `File`: a file; the value is `File` (in this package) - in the application's memory a path string.

property.description: One property: a value, optionally animated by keyframes, optionally driven by an expression.

hold_only.description: The editor creates only Hold keys for it. Default false.

keys.description: The keyframes in ascending time, no two at the same time, when they are NOT stored in the owner's keyframe-tracks node (profile document 6.5). Absent or empty: no inline keyframes.

match.description: What the property IS within its group (`position`, `opacity`, an effect parameter's id): the name a reader goes by. Not unique among siblings of an indexed list.

shown_dims.description: How many dimensions the editor shows (2 for a 2D position stored as Vec3); 0 = all. Default 0.

spatial.description: True: a 2D or 3D value moves along a motion path between keys (profile document 6.4). Default false.

static_only.description: The property cannot be animated. Default false.

three_d_only.description: The property applies only when its layer is 3D. Default false.

track.description: Index of this property's keyframe track in the owner's `core.keyframe.tracks` node (the payload's `tracks` field names the node). Never present together with a non-empty `keys`.

two_d_only.description: The property applies only when its layer is 2D. Default false.

uid.description: The property's id: unique in the project, never reused, unchanged by rename and reorder.

value.description: The static value: the property's value when it has no keyframes.

shape_path.description: A Bezier path: vertices with tangents RELATIVE to their vertex. Segment i is the cubic from vertices[i] with control points vertices[i] + out_tangents[i] and vertices[i+1] + in_tangents[i+1] to vertices[i+1]. Coordinates are layer pixels (masks) or the shape's own space (shape layers); x to the right, y down.

closed.description: True: a last segment joins the last vertex to the first. An open mask path cuts nothing out.

feather.description: Variable-width feather points. Absent means none.

in_tangents.description: One per vertex: the control point of the segment ARRIVING at the vertex, relative to it.

out_tangents.description: One per vertex: the control point of the segment LEAVING the vertex, relative to it.

text_doc.description: A text document: characters with document-wide formatting and optional per-run and per-paragraph formatting. Every field is optional with the application default. Character counts are Unicode scalar values.

baseline.description: Baseline option. `Normal`: on the baseline; `Superscript`: raised and reduced; `Subscript`: lowered and reduced.

baseline_shift.description: Shift of the baseline in layer pixels, positive up.

box_pos.description: Paragraph text: the centre of the text box relative to the layer origin, layer pixels.

anyOf.description: Paragraph text: the size of the text box in layer pixels (width, height); null: point text.

box_size.description: Paragraph text: the size of the text box in layer pixels (width, height); null: point text.

composer.description: Line-breaking method. Absent: `SingleLine`. `EveryLine`: line breaks chosen for the whole paragraph; `SingleLine`: line by line.

direction.description: Base direction. `Ltr`: left to right; `Rtl`: right to left.

fill.description: Fill colour: straight RGBA 0..1, binary32, authored-colour encoding.

font.description: Font family name (`Inter`). The font file is the node listed for (family, style) in the project node's `fonts`.

h_scale.description: Horizontal glyph scale in percent: 100 = unscaled.

hanging_punctuation.description: Punctuation may hang outside the text box.

justify.description: Paragraph alignment. `Left`: lines start at the anchor; `Center`: lines are centred on the anchor; `Right`: lines end at the anchor; `JustifyLastLeft`: justified, the last line left (paragraph text); `JustifyLastCenter`: justified, the last line centred; `JustifyLastRight`: justified, the last line right; `JustifyAll`: justified including the last line.

Manual.description: Kerning after the character in 1/1000 em.

kerning.description: Kerning: `Metrics` (the font's pairs), `Optical` (from glyph shapes), or {"Manual": n}.

anyOf.description: Line advance in layer pixels; null: automatic (1.2 * size).

leading.description: Line advance in layer pixels; null: automatic (1.2 * size).

paragraphs.description: Per-paragraph formatting, one entry per paragraph in order; paragraphs past the last entry, and all when absent, use the document's own.

items.description: The formatting of one paragraph. Fields as on the document; all optional.

composer.description: Line-breaking method. `EveryLine`: whole paragraph; `SingleLine`: line by line.

direction.description: Base direction. `Ltr`: left to right; `Rtl`: right to left.

justify.description: Alignment. `Left`: lines start at the anchor; `Center`: lines are centred on the anchor; `Right`: lines end at the anchor; `JustifyLastLeft`: justified, the last line left (paragraph text); `JustifyLastCenter`: justified, the last line centred; `JustifyLastRight`: justified, the last line right; `JustifyAll`: justified including the last line.

runs.description: Per-character formatting: consecutive runs covering the text from its start. Characters past the last run, and all of them when this is absent, have the document's own formatting (the fields above).

len.description: Length of the run in Unicode scalar values (code points).

size.description: Font size in layer pixels per em.

small_caps.description: Lower-case letters shown as small capitals.

space_after.description: Space after each paragraph, layer pixels.

space_before.description: Space before each paragraph, layer pixels.

stroke_over_fill.description: True: the stroke is drawn over the fill; false: under it.

tate_chu_yoko.description: Horizontal-in-vertical setting of the run (vertical text).

text.description: The characters. Lines are separated by U+000D or U+000A.

tracking.description: Extra advance after every character, in 1/1000 em.

v_scale.description: Vertical glyph scale in percent: 100 = unscaled.

items.description: [axis tag, value]: a variable-font axis (`wght`) and its setting (binary32).

vertical.description: Vertical text: lines run top to bottom, columns right to left.

vertical_roman_upright.description: Latin characters stand upright in vertical text.

tracker_settings.description: The settings of one motion tracker (its track points are child groups of the tracker group). All optional; defaults as given.

kind.description: Track type. Default `transform`. `stabilize`: stabilise the tracked layer itself; `transform`: apply position / rotation / scale to the target layer; `affine`: parallel corner pin (three points); `perspective`: perspective corner pin (four points); `raw`: track only; apply nothing.

action.description: What happens when confidence is below `threshold`. Default `adapt`. `continue`: go on; `stop`: stop tracking; `extrapolate`: extrapolate the motion; `adapt`: take a new feature image.

adaptEveryFrame.description: Take a new feature image every frame. Default false.

channel.description: What is compared. Default `luminance`. `rgb`: all three channels; `luminance`: luminance; `saturation`: saturation.

enhance.description: Enhance edges before matching. Default false.

threshold.description: Confidence below which `action` applies, percent 0..100. Default 80.

trackShape.description: Deform the feature region with the motion. Default true.

anyOf.description: Id of the layer the motion is applied to; null: none chosen.

target.description: Id of the layer the motion is applied to; null: none chosen.

v.description: r, g, b, a: 0..1 nominal (values outside are kept), in the encoding of authored colours (profile document 6.8).

then.description: a text document: the characters and their formatting
a reference to a layer of the same composition

a file carried in this package: the value of a parameter that names a file - one whose `ui.kind` is `File`, or a text parameter the writing application reads a file name from (a text parameter that holds the content itself stays `Str`)

value.description: A property value: `t` names its kind and `v` holds it. `Scalar`: one number; `Vec2`: two numbers (x, y); `Vec3`: three numbers (x, y, z); `Color`: a colour: straight (not premultiplied) RGBA; `Bool`: a switch; `Enum`: a choice; `Path`: a Bezier path; `Text`: a text document: the characters and their formatting; `Layer`: a reference to a layer of the same composition; `Gradient`: a gradient; `Str`: a string; `File`: a file carried in this package: the value of a parameter that names a file - one whose `ui.kind` is `File`, or a text parameter the writing application reads a file name from (a text parameter that holds the content itself stays `Str`). Scalar, Vec2, Vec3, Color, Path and Gradient interpolate between keyframes; the others step (profile document 6.3).

description: One layer of a composition: what it shows, when, its switches, and its property tree - transform, masks, effects, and the properties of its kind of source.

comp.description: Id of the composition the layer belongs to.

auto_orient.description: Automatic orientation. Default `Off`. `Off`: none; `AlongPath`: the layer turns to follow its motion path; `TowardsCamera`: a 3D layer faces the active camera; `TowardsPointOfInterest`: a camera or light points at its point of interest.

blend_mode.description: How the layer is mixed over what is below it. The formula of each mode is in the node `effect-catalog` (`blend_modes`) and in profile document 6.9.

environment.description: The layer is the environment (image-based light and reflections) of an Advanced 3D composition instead of being drawn. Default false.

environment_background.description: The layer's image is drawn as the 3D scene's backdrop, seen through the camera. Default false.

id.description: The layer's id: unique in the project, never reused.

in_point.description: The layer is active from this composition time (inclusive). Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

label.description: The layer's label. A colour label: a display aid with no effect on the picture.

markers.description: Layer markers; their times are layer time. Default none.

markers_locked.description: The markers are locked in the editor. Default false.

out_point.description: The layer is active up to this composition time (exclusive). Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

anyOf.description: Id of the layer of the same composition whose transform this layer's transform is relative to; null: the composition.

parent.description: Id of the layer of the same composition whose transform this layer's transform is relative to; null: the composition.

preserve_transparency.description: The layer's picture is multiplied by the alpha of what is below it before it is blended. Default false.

props.description: The root of the layer's property tree: a group whose children are the layer's property groups (`transform`, `masks`, `effects`, and those its kind of source has).

then.description: a solid item (also the footprint of an adjustment layer)

type.description: a solid item (also the footprint of an adjustment layer)

then.description: nothing: an invisible layer of 100 x 100 pixels used as a parent

type.description: nothing: an invisible layer of 100 x 100 pixels used as a parent

kind.description: The kind of light. `Parallel`: parallel rays; `Spot`: a cone; `Point`: all directions from a point; `Ambient`: everywhere, no direction; `Environment`: image-based light.

then.description: an imported 3D model (a footage item of kind `Model`)

type.description: an imported 3D model (a footage item of kind `Model`)

kind.description: Which primitive. `Cube`: cube; `Sphere`: sphere; `Plane`: plane; `Torus`: torus; `Cone`: cone; `Cylinder`: cylinder.

source.description: What the layer shows. `type` says which: `Footage`: a footage item; `Comp`: another composition, nested (a precomposition); `Solid`: a solid item (also the footprint of an adjustment layer); `Text`: text: the property group `text`; `Shape`: vector shapes: the property group `contents`; `Null`: nothing: an invisible layer of 100 x 100 pixels used as a parent; `Camera`: a camera: the property group `cameraOptions`; `Light`: a light: the property group `lightOptions`; `Model`: an imported 3D model (a footage item of kind `Model`); `Primitive`: a parametric 3D primitive.

start_time.description: The composition time at which the layer's own time is 0. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

stretch.description: Time stretch in percent: 100 = normal speed, 200 = half speed, negative = reversed. Layer time = (composition time - start_time) * 100 / stretch (profile document 6.2).

adjustment.description: The layer is an adjustment layer: its effects apply to everything below it (profile document 6.11).

collapse.description: A layer whose source is a composition: collapse transformations (profile document 6.13). Vector footage: rasterise at the on-screen scale.

effects.description: False: none of the layer's effects run.

frame_blend.description: Frame blending for footage and nested compositions played at another rate. `Off`: the nearest earlier source frame is shown; `FrameMix`: the two neighbouring source frames are mixed linearly; `PixelMotion`: an in-between frame is synthesised by optical flow (not defined by this profile).

guide.description: A guide layer: drawn in the editor, not in a render.

locked.description: Locked in the editor. No effect on the picture.

motion_blur.description: The layer is motion blurred (when the composition's `enable_motion_blur` is on).

quality.description: Quality. `Best`: interpolated sampling; `Draft`: nearest-neighbour sampling; `Wireframe`: only the outline of the layer's bounds, one pixel, white.

sampling.description: The resampling filter at `Best` quality. `Bilinear`: bilinear; `Bicubic`: bicubic.

shy.description: Shy in the editor. No effect on the picture.

solo.description: When any layer with a picture that is active at the time is solo, only solo layers are drawn.

anyOf.description: A track matte: another layer of the composition whose alpha or luminance limits this layer.

kind.description: What of the matte is used; this layer's premultiplied pixels are multiplied by clamp(k, 0, 1). `Alpha`: k = the matte's alpha; `AlphaInverted`: k = 1 - alpha; `Luma`: k = 0.2126 r + 0.7152 g + 0.0722 b of the matte's premultiplied colour; `LumaInverted`: k = 1 - that luminance.

track_matte.description: A track matte: another layer of the composition whose alpha or luminance limits this layer.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

anyOf.description: The `core.keyframe.tracks` node holding the keyframes of this payload's properties that carry `track`. Null or absent: none.

tracks.description: The `core.keyframe.tracks` node holding the keyframes of this payload's properties that carry `track`. Null or absent: none.
